name: Prince Ellis
source:
(Based loosely on Belle/Beauty from "Beauty and the Beast")

As the third and youngest prince of Rose Kingdom, Ellis has always known it is very unlikely he will one day become king and has never had to go through the vigorous training the heir does.  Instead of being involved in the struggle between his brothers for the throne, he prefers to spend time alone, reading and conducting his strange science experiments.
That is until it was announced that Ellis's elder brothers have both died from a mysterious illness, making him the only possible heir.  Worse still- many believe that he is the one who murdered his brothers to get the crown, and his refusal to speak about the tragedy and his general distant, quiet nature no doubt fuel the rumors.
Only time will tell what this eccentric prince is planning- and if he really caused his brothers' deaths.
